data.title: ‘It's awful’: How tariffs, soaring fuel costs and higher interest rates are squeezing American companies

data.title: Bessent meets China Vice Premier He Lifeng ahead of Trump-Xi summit
data.summary_raw: Scott Bessent and China’s He Lifeng are holding talks on trade, AI and critical minerals ahead of Trump and Xi’s Sept. 24 summit.

data.title: U.S. urges Americans to reconsider Middle East travel as Iran tensions rise
